🔄 Updated information (published September 21, 2026 / previously listed May 11, 2026)

Key changes: Gathering time moved from June 16 at 10:00 to November 21 at 8:30 a.m. Gathering location changed from the west side parking lot of Hanno City Hall to Kaji Elementary School. Route now covers the Kaji district. Distance increased from approximately 7 kilometers to approximately 12 kilometers. Registration method changed to advance registration at the Kaji East District Administrative Center by November 11.

We are holding the 32nd Kaji Tekuteku Walk. You will walk an approximately 12-kilometer course through the Kaji district, passing through Saikoji Temple, Dairenji Temple, Momiji Park, and other locations.

Date and time: Saturday, November 21, 2026 (Reiwa 8), gathering at 8:30 a.m.
Gathering location: Kaji Elementary School
Duration: Approximately 3 hours 30 minutes
Fee: Free
What to bring: Packed lunch, beverages, rain gear, ground sheet, Sogo-ashi handbook (if you have one)
Registration deadline: Wednesday, November 11
How to register: Contact Kaji East District Administrative Center
• Phone: 042-974-4546
• Fax: 042-972-9806
• Email: kajih-center@city.hanno.lg.jp

The event will be cancelled in case of severe weather. A decision will be made at 7:00 a.m. on the day. If conditions are unclear, please contact the Kaji East District Administrative Center for information.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/12785.html
summary: ℹ️ Sogo-ashi Event: 32nd Kaji Tekuteku Walk, Saturday, November 21, 2026
